success.title: Celebrating Success: Our Students Among Rwanda's Best
success.description: Saint Joseph TSS Nzuki is proud to announce a historic achievement! Two of our students, Karangwa Irakoze Roben and Aime Senga Prosper, from the Automobile Technology combination (AUT) in S6, have been ranked among the top 10 students in the nationwide Transport and Logistics results for the year 2025. This incredible accomplishment is a testament to their hard work, dedication, and the high-quality education provided by our school.
success.congratsText: We extend our heartfelt congratulations to our exceptional students who have made history:

school.girlsDormitoryDesc: A safe and nurturing environment for our female students, equipped with modern amenities and dedicated staff.
school.boysDormitoryDesc: A comfortable and secure dormitory for our male students, fostering a sense of community and belonging.
school.visionText: To create dynamic and collaborative professional relationships that transcend current barriers and borders with local and international partners, in order to maximize the technical learning of our students.
school.missionText: To maximize the technical learning of our students, we will acquire modern and appropriate teaching materials that support the best CBT/CBA teaching methods, in order to train learners who are skilled, responsible, and trustworthy professionals in the job market.

academics.achievementsText: Our students have excelled in national examinations and technical competitions. Many graduates are successfully working in industries or running their own businesses. St Joseph TSS Nzuki continues to produce skilled professionals who contribute to Rwanda's development.
